company: CHINA RESOURCES BEER HOLDING HONG KONG
description: China Resources Beer (Holdings) Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture, distribution, and sale of alcoholic beverages in Mainland China. It offers beer and baijiu products under the Guizhou and Jinsha Huisha brands. The company was formerly known as China Resources Enterprise, Limited and changed its name to China Resources Beer (Holdings) Company Limited in October 2015. The company is based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong. China Resources Beer (Holdings) Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of CRH (Beer) Limited.
